content_fields.title: Test to confirm that authorization and authentication controls are in place for access to resources
content_fields.description: Require authentication and authorization on every route, including ones hidden from the OpenAPI schema.
content_fields.finding: The delivery orders endpoint declares no authentication or authorization dependency and is merely hidden from the schema.
criteria: Enumerating the route table shows no handler without an authentication dependency, except the documented public ones.
`include_in_schema=False` is never the only thing protecting a route.
An anonymous request to /delivery/orders and /debug returns 401 or 404.
